2) Finance (Lauren) will confirm ACH details and whether we can issue an initial PO while we resolve any name/DBA mismatches.
3) For our records we need a copy of either: (a) a Certificate of Formation / Articles of Organization that show Paragon Networks, LLC, or (b) a recent invoice with the EIN printed. If you can drop one of those that will speed things up.

I also sent the vendor profile link below — please complete the short fields flagged in yellow (tax name, tax classification, DBA field). That populates into our AP system and helps avoid manual corrections later.

Vendor form: https://redwood-inference.onboarding/vender-form?acct=paragon-12345

Monica — can you triage and let us know if there are any obvious blockers? Lauren — if ACH info matches bank letter, can we do a provisional PO (<= $25K) while tax name is clarified?

Thanks,
Connor

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Paragon vendor docs — EIN/name reconciliation needed (internal)

Connor / Lauren — I reviewed the W-9, Articles of Organization, bank letter and invoice. There is a subtle mismatch: the IRS EIN notice and Articles show "Paragon Networks, LLC" (correct), but the bank letter lists the account under "Paragon Cloud Services" (DBA). Our vendor onboarding policy requires the bank account holder name to match the tax name unless we have a signed affidavit linking the DBA to the legal entity.

Options to clear:
- Vendor can provide a short affidavit on letterhead stating that "Paragon Cloud Services" is a trade name for Paragon Networks, LLC and is authorized to receive ACH for the company (signed by an officer), OR
- Re-issue the W-9 listing the legal name and include the DBA in the "business name/disregarded entity" line (signed), OR
- Provide bank documentation that shows both the legal name and DBA on the account (rare).

Recommend we place PO issuance on hold until we receive one of the above. Per policy, I'll mark the vendor record as "pending tax reconciliation" so AP doesn't pay against incomplete profile. Connor — please advise if procurement is comfortable with a partial/provisional PO for a first, low-dollar order (Finance sign-off required).

Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Sofia Torres <sofia@paragon-ops.com>

> Connor / Lauren — I reviewed the W-9, Articles of Organization, bank letter and invoice. There is a subtle mismatch...

Thanks for the quick review, Monica — we can get you the affidavit today. I spoke with our CFO and she will sign a short statement linking Paragon Cloud Services as a DBA of Paragon Networks, LLC and authorizing ACH payments. We expect to upload the signed affidavit by 5pm PT today.

Regarding a provisional PO — we would appreciate a small initial PO to kick off the integration work (proof-of-concept). If you can do a provisional PO up to $10,000 while we deliver the affidavit, that would keep the project timeline intact. If Finance needs any extra assurances we can provide an additional email from our CFO confirming account ownership.

Attachments: [attachment: confirmation_note_from_cfo.txt (text/plain)]

Appreciate your help — we will follow up when affidavit is uploaded.

Sofia
Director of Finance | Paragon Networks
